display_name: 固定物理后验残差的源域幅度诊断
description: 固定已训练残差网络，在先验和残差训练 ID 之外的源记录上检查修正幅度、方向及伪标签一致数。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU0 single process, CPU 2 threads, TF32 disabled, source-only fixed-state smoke

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: source IQ [2,256]; no truth labels; fixed residual scales 0,1,4,16
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels, U_s truth, V or target read; residual parent previously used legitimate L_s training labels.
data.validation_ref: 448 source train role records, 64 each clean and six impaired, disjoint from parent residual fit and prior IDs; earlier source views seen

permissions.query_use: Source-only fixed scaling diagnostic, no V/test/truth or automatic model selection
permissions.claim_scope: Source physical IDs observed in previous channel views, RX8 same prior pilot; no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed blind estimator, conditional prior, trained residual corrector and frozen F; DURA source comparison only.

checkpoint.selection_rule: No selection: fixed scale0,1,4,16 only; source classification pseudo agreement and IQ errors reported separately.
